assets.title: Bored Barrel Rolling Pin
assets.description: One original low-poly rolling pin counted as one complete fixed static visual prop. A thick pale maple-coloured barrel has a long straight work-surface silhouette, softened polygonal shoulders and a genuine full-length octagonal through-bore. One independent continuous satin steel-coloured shaft rests on the entire finite lower bore facet in the single frozen pose; all seven other complete bore facets remain clear. Two separate dark walnut-coloured grips each have a short neck, swelling body and rounded blunt end, with finite embedded shaft joints and visible gaps from both barrel ends. The barrel rests on one finite bottom facet while both grips stay above ground. Four named editable closed meshes and three opaque constant PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. No dough, flour, table, stand, labels, textures or animation. Static visual geometry only: no rolling, kneading, food contact, sanitation, hand fit, resistance, load, durability, manufacturing, stability or tool safety claim. No dimensional compatibility with historical bowls, tables or dough assets is asserted.
